name: Beginner Friendly Vortix Spear + Fast Castle
author: taktaktab

notes: 1 Vill builds @building_military/barracks.webp@ , 2 Vills to @resource/sheep.webp@, 2 Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Builld a @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ next to the @resource/berrybush.webp@ with the @building_military/barracks.webp@ Builder vill once @building_military/barracks.webp@ is done.
Produce 2@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ from @building_military/barracks.webp@ (could go for 3@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ if needed*)

once we have 75 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ we get @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@ and move one @resource/resource_wood.webp@ vill to build @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ by the @resource/resource_gold.webp@
once @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ is done send the builder Vill to@resource/resource_gold.webp@  and move 2 vills from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
once @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@ is done send all all sheep vills to @resource/berrybush.webp@
Keep @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Once we have 50 move @resource/resource_wood.webp@ move the @resource/resource_wood.webp@ Vill to build another @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ next to @resource/berrybush.webp@
after finishiing the @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ the vill will go onto @resource/berrybush.webp@
Use 2 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills to age up with @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ on the woodline
Movev 2 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for a totall of 5

Note: Try to save your 2-3 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend vs any cav that tries to harras your @resource/resource_gold.webp@. if this is not possible then invest 1-2 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ Vills into @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to make either a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ or more @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ based on what the opponent is building.
(The rest of this guide assumes that we did not need to move any Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@)*
Once @resource/berrybush.webp@ is done, move the @resource/berrybush.webp@ Vills to @resource/sheep.webp@
Once @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ is done, move the 2 builder Vills to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Age up with 8 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills and build @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@
Move 5 @resource/sheep.webp@Vills to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
(We Need 200  @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for a @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ and then a @building_military/stable.webp@)
1 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vill Builds @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ asap
Queue up @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@ in @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Once aged up,  5 @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ builder vills builld @building_military/stable.webp@ and then they go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Move the remaining 3 @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@builder vills to @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@ .
Note: Continue to move @resource/sheep.webp@Vills to @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@ when they become available

Once @building_military/stable.webp@ is done, put @ability_japanese/ability-place-yorishiro.webp@ in @building_military/stable.webp@ and make @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@/@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@

Grab @resource/relics.webp@ and if opponent is passive (you have map controll) get @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and raid with @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@/@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@
Continue the rest of the game and make sure to macro based on your needs:
(eg: for @unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@ go more on wood)

description:
This build order inspired by Vortix's Rush+Fast Castle Build Order but it has been changed to make it easier for beginners (therfore it is easier to follow but most likely worse than the original build). 
The main difference is that we go on barry as soon as Tawara upgrade is done, we do this to preserve sheep for a safe food source vs raiding civs. 

Heads up: The timings might be off in the game based on walking distances of the Vills (Villagers) to the resources and etc.
